# VP-039: test fixture for T-045 15-byte last_amended control

Fixture: VP file with `version: "2"` and `last_amended: "2026-07-30 (v2)"` (15 bytes).

VP files do NOT trigger Arm A1 (A1 is BC-file-only). This isolates Class E1.
`extract_last_amended_outer_version("2026-07-30 (v2)")` must return `Some("2")`.
After fix (len threshold lowered to 14): "2" == "2" → no E1 violation → exit 0.
F-S2107-P1C-014: len < 17 would return None → unparseable advisory → exit 0 but warn in log.

BC-5.39.010 v1.3 §E1: YYYY-MM-DD (vN) with single-digit outer version is valid.
